title: Amwill Health Care to Import, Market Private-Label Hair Colour Products From Thailand

contentHtml:
Bengaluru: Amwill Health Care Limited has entered into an exclusive manufacturing, private label supply, import and non-disclosure agreement with a leading pharmaceutical manufacturing company based in Thailand to expand its hair colour product portfolio in India.

Under the agreement, the Thailand-based manufacturer will manufacture hair colour products for Amwill Health Care under its own brand through a private-label arrangement. Amwill will be responsible for importing the products and undertaking their marketing and distribution in India and the designated territory.

The agreement has been executed on an exclusive basis for a period of five years and may be renewed through mutual consent between the parties. The Thai manufacturer will be responsible for ensuring that the products are manufactured in accordance with applicable Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and quality standards, while Amwill will oversee regulatory registrations, marketing and distribution.

The company clarified that the agreement does not involve any upfront payment. The arrangement is expected to broaden Amwill's hair colour product portfolio, strengthen and diversify its sourcing of quality products and enable it to offer a wider range of products to customers.

The company further stated that the anticipated benefits will depend on regulatory approvals, prevailing market conditions and commercial performance.
